summary: scripts/evidence-log-watch (with a 2-minute systemd timer) alerts when the published evidence log head is older than 360 s or unreadable for that long: once when the stall begins, hourly while it lasts, and once when it recovers

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; nothing a verifier reads changes.

compatibility.detail: A new host-side tool; nothing runs it until a host installs its timer.

manual.detail: To install on a host: copy scripts/evidence-log-watch to ~/.local/bin, put EVIDENCE_LOG_WATCH_NOTIFY (a JSON argv) in ~/.config/evidence-log-watch/env, install the .service and .timer as user units and enable the timer.

recovery.detail: Its only state is ~/.local/state/evidence-log-watch; removing it starts the watch afresh.
